accessible_toilet.note: In the foyer and next to many of the screens

sources.quote: There's step-free access to the wheelchair spaces and adjoining seats, and accessible toilets in the foyer and adjacent to many of the screens.

assistance_dogs.note: Vue: assistance dogs welcome in all venues

sources.quote: We welcome assistance dogs into all our venues.

hearing_assist_counters.note: Loops at all counters; a lowered counter

sources.quote: There are hearing loops at all of the counters, where food, drinks and tickets can be purchased, and pre-purchased tickets can be collected.

lift.note: From all levels of the shopping centre

sources.quote: The venue is accessible from all levels of the shopping centre by lift and escalator.

notes: The page says there is wheelchair access in all screens and step-free access to the wheelchair spaces, but doesn't list the screens or their wheelchair spaces.

step_free_access.note: Wheelchair access throughout and in all screens

sources.quote: Vue Westfield Stratford City has wheelchair access throughout the venue and in all screens.
